args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, making returns a major cost driver for retailers (blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns).
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%) compared to distributed processing.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin (insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion).
args.title: Bellwether 2026 Returns: Combined Summary
